criteria.1.1: WHEN a shopper buys a Gift_Card with a whole-dollar value from 10 to 500 dollars inclusive, THE Shop_API SHALL charge the Payment_Provider that value.
criteria.1.2: WHEN a Gift_Card is created, THE Shop_API SHALL return its 16-character code.
criteria.1.3: IF the Payment_Provider declines the charge or does not respond within 10 seconds, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return HTTP 402 with error `payment_failed`.
criteria.1.4: IF the Payment_Provider declines the charge or does not respond within 10 seconds, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL create no Gift_Card.
criteria.1.5: WHEN the Payment_Provider charge for a Gift_Card purchase succeeds, THE Shop_API SHALL create an `active` Gift_Card with a balance equal to the charged value.
criteria.1.6: IF the Payment_Provider does not respond within 10 seconds, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL cancel or refund any charge that the Payment_Provider later confirms for that purchase.
criteria.1.7: IF the purchase value is not a whole-dollar value from 10 to 500 dollars inclusive, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return HTTP 422 with error `invalid_request`.
criteria.1.8: IF the purchase value is not a whole-dollar value from 10 to 500 dollars inclusive, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL not charge the Payment_Provider.
criteria.1.9: WHEN the Shop_API receives a purchase request with an idempotency key that it already processed, THE Shop_API SHALL return the first result.
criteria.1.10: WHEN the Shop_API receives a purchase request with an idempotency key that it already processed, THE Shop_API SHALL not charge the Payment_Provider again.
criteria.2.1: WHEN a shopper applies an `active` Gift_Card code to a Cart with a subtotal not above the Gift_Card balance, THE Shop_API SHALL subtract the Cart subtotal from the Gift_Card balance.
criteria.2.2: THE Shop_API SHALL respond to a redemption request within 2 seconds for 95 percent of requests.
criteria.2.3: THE Shop_API SHALL accept Gift_Cards with a balance up to 500 dollars.
criteria.2.4: IF the code is 16 characters and does not match any Gift_Card, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return HTTP 404 with error `unknown_card`.
criteria.2.5: WHEN the Cart subtotal exceeds the Gift_Card balance, THE Shop_API SHALL set the Gift_Card balance to 0.
criteria.2.6: WHEN the Cart subtotal exceeds the Gift_Card balance, THE Shop_API SHALL return the remaining amount due in cents.
criteria.2.7: THE Shop_API SHALL apply concurrent redemptions and voids on one Gift_Card in sequence, so that the balance never falls below 0.
criteria.2.8: IF the code is not 16 characters or the Cart is not open, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return HTTP 422 with error `invalid_request`.
criteria.2.9: THE Shop_API SHALL check redemption requests in this order: `invalid_request` (422), `unknown_card` (404), `card_void` (409), and return the first error that applies.
criteria.3.1: WHEN a staff member voids a Gift_Card through the Merchant_Portal, THE Shop_API SHALL set the Gift_Card status to `void`.
criteria.3.2: WHILE a Gift_Card is `void`, THE Shop_API SHALL reject redemption with HTTP 409 and error `card_void`.
criteria.3.3: IF a void request has no staff actor id or the actor id does not belong to a staff member, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return HTTP 403 with error `forbidden`.
criteria.3.4: IF a void request has no staff actor id or the actor id does not belong to a staff member, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL not change the Gift_Card.
criteria.4.1: THE Shop_API SHALL keep Gift_Card balances forever; Gift_Cards never expire.
criteria.5.1: WHEN a Gift_Card balance or status changes, THE Shop_API SHALL append a ledger entry with the code, old value, new value, actor id, and UTC timestamp.
criteria.5.2: IF the ledger write fails, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL reject the change with HTTP 503 and error `ledger_unavailable`.
criteria.5.3: IF the ledger write for a new Gift_Card fails after the Payment_Provider charge, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL refund the charge.
criteria.5.4: IF the refund of a charge fails, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL record the charge for manual refund.
